title: Pack the Satchel
narrative: One more crate for the road. Add it to the end of the satchel and report how many crates it now carries.
instructions:
The System provides `satchel` (a list) and `item` (the crate to add). Do not assign either yourself.

- Add `item` to the END of the `satchel` list.
- Then store how many crates the satchel now holds in a variable called `crate_count`.
starting_code:
# `satchel` and `item` are provided by the System (do not reassign them).
# Add `item` to the end of the satchel, then count what it holds.

crate_count =
hints: Add to the end with `satchel.append(item)` on its own line.
Do them in order: append first, then `crate_count = len(satchel)`.
append changes the list in place — you don't need to reassign it.
